verdict.rationale: Kimi spans an assistant, a coding agent and a developer API platform with OpenAPI and Admin API specs, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no MCP server, hosted MCP endpoint or 'mcp serve' mode. The closest items are ACP editor connectivity and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, which are adjacent integrations rather than an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
